## Library and transparent provider

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_PROTOCOL</code> | `rocev2` | `rocev2`, `uet`, or `dummy` | Select the wire protocol used by newly opened contexts. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet ./examples/direct_traffic uet</code> |
| <code>UIB_BIND_IP</code> | `0.0.0.0` | An IPv4 address assigned to the local host. | Select the local IPv4 address used by the verbs provider. | <code>UIB_BIND_IP=192.0.2.2 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_BIND_PORT</code> | 4791 for RoCEv2 and 5432 for UET. | `1` through `65535` | Override the protocol's local UDP or TCP service port. | <code>UIB_BIND_PORT=5432 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE</code> | `udp-io-uring` | `udp-io-uring`, `udp-sync`, `udp-zc-afxdp`, or `tcp-devmem` | Select the packet transport independently of the wire protocol. | <code>UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=udp-sync ./examples/direct_traffic rocev2</code> |
| <code>UIB_RETRY_TIMEOUT_US</code> | `20000` microseconds | `1000` through `60000000` | Set the initial retransmission timeout used by reliable RoCEv2 and UET queue pairs. Increase it for high-latency paths; decrease it for tightly controlled simulations where faster loss recovery is required. | <code>UIB_RETRY_TIMEOUT_US=50000 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_STATS_OUTPUT</code> | `off` | `off` or `stderr` | Emit one machine-readable `UIB_STATS` JSON record when each context closes. Simulation collectors use `stderr` to verify the selected UIB backend and aggregate its packet and zero-copy counters without application changes. Statistics are diagnostic evidence and do not change application results. | <code>UIB_STATS_OUTPUT=stderr LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UDP_MODE</code> | `socket` | `socket` or `raw`; raw requires `CAP_NET_RAW`. | Select ordinary UDP sockets or raw RoCEv2 interoperability. | <code>UIB_UDP_MODE=raw LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so ibv_rc_pingpong</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_RX_MODE</code> | `auto` | `auto`, `multishot`, or `batch` | Select multishot receive or the portable batched fallback. | <code>UIB_URING_RX_MODE=batch ./tests/loopback</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_RX_BATCH</code> | `64` | `1` through `256` | Set RX CQEs reaped per worker pass and batched RX depth. | <code>UIB_URING_RX_BATCH=128 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_TX_BATCH</code> | `64` | `1` through `256` | Limit send SQEs submitted by the io_uring worker per pass. | <code>UIB_URING_TX_BATCH=128 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL</code> | `off` | `off` or `on` | Enable the optional io_uring kernel submission polling thread. | <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL=on ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL_IDLE</code> | `2000` | A positive number of milliseconds. | Set how long an idle io_uring SQPOLL thread keeps polling. | <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL=on UIB_URING_SQPOLL_IDLE=100 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL_CPU</code> | Unset. | An online CPU number. | Pin the optional io_uring SQPOLL kernel thread to one CPU. | <code>UIB_URING_SQPOLL=on UIB_URING_SQPOLL_CPU=3 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_ZEROCOPY</code> | `auto` | `off`, `auto`, `on`, or `required` | Control optional socket and AF_XDP transmit zero-copy. | <code>UIB_ZEROCOPY=required ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_ZEROCOPY_THRESHOLD</code> | 10240 in auto mode; 1024 in on or required mode. | A non-negative byte count. | Override the minimum packet size used for socket zero-copy. | <code>UIB_ZEROCOPY_THRESHOLD=4096 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |

## Transparent provider

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_ACTIVE_MTU</code> | `auto` | `auto`, `256`, `512`, `1024`, `2048`, or `4096` | Set the active verbs port MTU advertised to applications. Auto selects the largest verbs MTU with a 64-byte allowance below the interface MTU matched by UIB_BIND_IP. Unknown interfaces and invalid values use 4096. | <code>UIB_ACTIVE_MTU=1024 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so ibv_rc_pingpong</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_WIRE_MTU</code> | The verbs-negotiated path MTU. | `4096` or `8192` | Promote a negotiated 4096-byte UET path to an 8192-byte wire packet. Both peers must use UIB and the network interface MTU must be at least 8256. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_WIRE_MTU=8192 app</code> |

## UDP transports

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_UDP_WORKERS</code> | `auto`, one receive-dispatch worker per allowed CPU | `auto` or a positive integer | Set the number of UDP receive-dispatch workers. Packets for one QP always use the same worker, while different QPs can be processed in parallel. With affinity enabled, an explicit count cannot exceed the process's allowed CPU count. | <code>UIB_UDP_WORKERS=8 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UDP_WORKER_AFFINITY</code> | `on` | `off` or `on` | Pin UDP receive-dispatch workers and optional multi-flow RX/TX lane threads to CPUs from the process's allowed CPU set. Set this to `off` when an external scheduler manages thread placement. | <code>UIB_UDP_WORKERS=4 UIB_UDP_WORKER_AFFINITY=off app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UDP_GSO</code> | `auto` | `auto`, `off`, or `on` | Combine equal-sized RDMA packets into UDP GSO sends. `on` fails context creation when the kernel does not support UDP GSO; `auto` falls back. | <code>UIB_UDP_GSO=off ./examples/stress_bench --protocol rocev2</code> |

## Ultra Ethernet transmit path

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_TX_WORKERS</code> | `auto`, one preparation worker per allowed CPU | `auto` or a positive integer | Set the number of persistent workers that prepare admitted UET work requests. PSN assignment, ordered publication, ACK handling, retries, congestion control, and CQ production remain sequenced per QP. With affinity enabled, an explicit count cannot exceed the process's allowed CPU count. | <code>UIB_TX_WORKERS=8 LD_PRELOAD=$PWD/libuibv.so app</code> |
| <code>UIB_TX_WORKER_AFFINITY</code> | `on` | `off` or `on` | Pin UET preparation workers to distinct CPUs in the process's allowed CPU set. Set this to `off` when a scheduler or launcher controls placement. | <code>UIB_TX_WORKERS=4 UIB_TX_WORKER_AFFINITY=off app</code> |

## Ultra Ethernet UDP scaling

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_UDP_FLOWS</code> | `1`, one UDP flow | a positive integer from `1` through `64` | Select the number of UDP data flows used by UET with `udp-sync`. Values greater than one distribute a QP's messages across independent, bounded TX and RX lanes. This mode is optional and disabled by default. Every packet of one message remains on the same lane; adjacent messages may use different lanes. The QP receive sequencer preserves PSN, WQE, congestion-control, and completion ordering across the lanes. Each lane uses the base UDP port plus `(lane + 1) * 128`; those ports must be free and allowed by host and container networking. Multi-flow mode requires `udp-sync`, cannot be used with raw UDP, and rejects `UIB_ZEROCOPY=required`. | <code>UIB_UDP_FLOWS=4 UIB_TX_WORKERS=4 app</code> |

## AF_XDP transport

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_AFXDP_IFACE</code> | Unset; AF_XDP is unavailable until it is set. | A local network-interface name. | Select the netdev to which the AF_XDP socket is attached. | <code>UIB_AFXDP_IFACE=eth0 UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=udp-zc-afxdp app</code> |
| <code>UIB_AFXDP_QUEUE</code> | `0` | A non-negative queue identifier. | Select the hardware RX/TX queue used by the AF_XDP socket. | <code>UIB_AFXDP_QUEUE=1 UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=udp-zc-afxdp app</code> |
| <code>UIB_AFXDP_PEER_MAC</code> | Unset; it is mandatory for AF_XDP. | A six-octet colon-separated MAC address. | Set the fixed next-hop destination MAC for emitted frames. | <code>UIB_AFXDP_PEER_MAC=02:00:00:00:00:02 app</code> |

## TCP devmem transport

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_DEVMEM_IFACE</code> | Unset; device-memory queue binding is disabled. | A local network-interface name. | Select the netdev whose RX queue receives DMA-BUF binding. | <code>UIB_DEVMEM_IFACE=eth0 UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=tcp-devmem app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DEVMEM_QUEUE</code> | `0` | A non-negative queue identifier. | Select the netdev RX queue used for DMA-BUF binding. | <code>UIB_DEVMEM_QUEUE=1 UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=tcp-devmem app</code> |

## Provider-owned host-memory receive

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_HOST_ZC</code> | `auto` | `auto`, `off`, or `required` | Enable TCP io_uring ZCRX when its NIC queue and kernel support are usable. | <code>UIB_HOST_ZC=required UIB_HOST_ZC_IFACE=eth0 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_HOST_ZC_IFACE</code> | Unset; ZCRX remains inactive. | A network-interface name configured for TCP header/data split. | Select the interface whose hardware receive queue backs the ZCRX arena. | <code>UIB_HOST_ZC_IFACE=eth0 UIB_TRANSPORT_MODE=tcp-devmem app</code> |
| <code>UIB_HOST_ZC_QUEUE</code> | `0` | A non-negative hardware receive-queue identifier. | Select the flow-steered hardware queue registered with io_uring ZCRX. | <code>UIB_HOST_ZC_QUEUE=1 UIB_HOST_ZC_IFACE=eth0 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_VIRTME_KERNEL</code> | Unset; virtme-ng chooses its default kernel. | A kernel image path accepted by `vng --run`. | Select the kernel image used by the focused host zero-copy VM tests. | <code>UIB_VIRTME_KERNEL=/boot/vmlinuz-test make host-zc-virtme-test</code> |

## Ultra Ethernet

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_UET_CC</code> | `nscc` | `nscc`, `rccc`, `none`, experimental `dcqcn`, or a registered name | Select the congestion-control algorithm for UET queue pairs. Use `none` only as an experimental baseline because it removes congestion-window admission control. DCQCN is native to RoCEv2 and requires `UIB_UET_CC_EXPERIMENTAL=on` when selected for UET. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_CC=none ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_CC_EXPERIMENTAL</code> | `off` | `off` or `on` | Permit a congestion algorithm that is native to another protocol. This gate is required for DCQCN-on-UET research and does not affect UET-native NSCC or RCCC. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_CC=dcqcn UIB_UET_CC_EXPERIMENTAL=on app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_NSCC_MAX_WND</code> | The maximum window calculated by NSCC configuration. | A byte count no smaller than the active MTU. | Cap the initial NSCC congestion window for experiments. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_NSCC_MAX_WND=65536 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_OPTIMIZED</code> | `auto` | `off`, `auto`, `small`, or `medium` | Select the SES request-header optimization policy. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_OPTIMIZED=medium app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_MULTIPATH</code> | `off` | `off`, `oblivious`, or `path-aware` | Select entropy multipathing and path-failure tracking mode. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_MULTIPATH=path-aware app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_DEBUG</code> | Unset and disabled. | Any non-empty value enables logging. | Enable diagnostic UET packet and completion logging. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_DEBUG=1 ./tests/loopback</code> |

## Ultra Ethernet RCCC

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_UET_RCCC_MAX_WND</code> | One and a half times the configured bandwidth-delay product. | A byte count no smaller than the active MTU. | Set the RCCC speculative and outstanding byte window. | <code>UIB_UET_CC=rccc UIB_UET_RCCC_MAX_WND=262144 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_RCCC_CREDIT_QUANTUM</code> | Four active-MTU packets. | A byte count no smaller than the active MTU. | Set the amount of source credit issued by one destination scheduling turn. | <code>UIB_UET_CC=rccc UIB_UET_RCCC_CREDIT_QUANTUM=16384 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_RCCC_LINK_RATE</code> | `12500000000` bytes per second. | A positive byte-per-second rate. | Set the source and destination link rate used for RCCC credit pacing. | <code>UIB_UET_CC=rccc UIB_UET_RCCC_LINK_RATE=50000000000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_RCCC_BASE_RTT</code> | `12000` nanoseconds. | A positive nanosecond duration. | Set the base RTT used to derive the RCCC bandwidth-delay product. | <code>UIB_UET_CC=rccc UIB_UET_RCCC_BASE_RTT=20000 app</code> |

## RoCEv2

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC</code> | `none` | `none`, `dcqcn`, a registered name, or experimental `nscc` | Select the congestion-control algorithm for RoCEv2 RC queue pairs. DCQCN is the protocol-native implementation. NSCC was designed for Ultra Ethernet, not RoCEv2; selecting it here is an experimental-only cross-protocol research mode, not a deployment default or recommendation. RoCEv2 defaults to `none`. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=rocev2 UIB_ROCEV2_CC=nscc app</code> |
| <code>UIB_ROCEV2_NSCC_MAX_WND</code> | The maximum window calculated by NSCC configuration. | A byte count no smaller than the active MTU plus wire overhead. | Cap the initial NSCC congestion window for experimental RoCEv2 comparison runs. NSCC was designed for Ultra Ethernet; its use with RoCEv2 is experimental only and is not a production congestion-control recommendation. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=rocev2 UIB_ROCEV2_CC=nscc UIB_ROCEV2_NSCC_MAX_WND=65536 app</code> |

## DCQCN

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_INITIAL_RATE</code> | `12500000000` bytes per second. | A positive rate between the configured minimum and maximum. | Set the DCQCN source rate before congestion feedback arrives. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_INITIAL_RATE=50000000000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_MINIMUM_RATE</code> | `12500000` bytes per second. | A positive rate no greater than the initial rate. | Set the minimum rate retained after congestion feedback. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_MINIMUM_RATE=125000000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_MAXIMUM_RATE</code> | `12500000000` bytes per second. | A positive rate no smaller than the initial rate. | Cap DCQCN rate recovery at the configured link rate. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_MAXIMUM_RATE=50000000000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_ADDITIVE_INCREASE</code> | `625000` bytes per second per recovery interval. | A positive byte-per-second rate increment. | Set the target-rate increase after DCQCN fast recovery. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_ADDITIVE_INCREASE=1250000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_RECOVERY_INTERVAL</code> | `55000` nanoseconds. | A positive nanosecond duration. | Set the DCQCN alpha update and rate-recovery interval. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_RECOVERY_INTERVAL=100000 app</code> |
| <code>UIB_DCQCN_ALPHA_GAIN</code> | `256`, or 1/256 in Q16 fixed-point units. | An integer from `1` through `65536`. | Set the EWMA gain used for the DCQCN congestion estimate. | <code>UIB_ROCEV2_CC=dcqcn UIB_DCQCN_ALPHA_GAIN=512 app</code> |

## Stress benchmark executable

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_BENCH_PROTOCOL</code> | `uet` | `rocev2`, `uet`, or `dummy` | Select the protocol when `--protocol` is not supplied. | <code>UIB_BENCH_PROTOCOL=rocev2 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_MEMORY</code> | `host` | `host`, `dmabuf`, or `gpu-dmabuf` | Select the memory kind used for benchmark payloads. | <code>UIB_BENCH_MEMORY=dmabuf ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_ROLE</code> | `local` | `local`, `server`, or `client` | Select local or remote endpoint operation. | <code>UIB_BENCH_ROLE=server ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_BIND</code> | A role-specific loopback address. | An IPv4 address assigned to the local host. | Set the local IPv4 address in remote benchmark mode. | <code>UIB_BENCH_BIND=192.0.2.1 UIB_BENCH_ROLE=server ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_PEER</code> | Unset; it is required in client mode. | A reachable IPv4 address. | Set the remote server address used by a benchmark client. | <code>UIB_BENCH_PEER=192.0.2.1 UIB_BENCH_ROLE=client ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_ITERATIONS</code> | `10000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set the number of measured RDMA operations. | <code>UIB_BENCH_ITERATIONS=100000 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_SIZE</code> | 4096 bytes; the full matrix selects 32768. | A positive 32-bit byte count. | Set the payload size of each measured operation. | <code>UIB_BENCH_SIZE=65536 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_WINDOW</code> | `64` | A positive queue-window size. | Set the maximum number of operations kept in flight. | <code>UIB_BENCH_WINDOW=128 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_MTU</code> | `1500` | A positive byte count; RoCEv2 is limited to 4096. | Set the protocol path MTU used by benchmark QPs. | <code>UIB_BENCH_MTU=4096 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_CONTROL_PORT</code> | `19190` | `1` through `65535` | Select the TCP control-plane port for remote mode. | <code>UIB_BENCH_CONTROL_PORT=20190 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_DATA_PORT</code> | `19100` | `1` through `65535` | Select the UIB data-plane port for remote mode. | <code>UIB_BENCH_DATA_PORT=20100 ./examples/stress_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_DMABUF_FD</code> | Unset; required by `gpu-dmabuf` memory mode. | A valid inherited file-descriptor number. | Supply an already-open GPU DMA-BUF descriptor to import. | <code>UIB_BENCH_DMABUF_FD=9 ./examples/stress_bench --memory gpu-dmabuf</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_DMABUF_OFFSET</code> | `0` | A non-negative byte offset. | Set the byte offset into an imported GPU DMA-BUF. | <code>UIB_BENCH_DMABUF_OFFSET=4096 UIB_BENCH_DMABUF_FD=9 app</code> |

## Complete benchmark matrix

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_BENCH_PROTOCOLS</code> | `rocev2 uet dummy` | A space-separated subset of supported protocols. | Select the protocols traversed by the matrix runner. | <code>UIB_BENCH_PROTOCOLS='rocev2 uet' make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_MEMORY_MODES</code> | `host dmabuf` | A space-separated subset of `host` and `dmabuf`. | Select the memory kinds traversed by the matrix runner. | <code>UIB_BENCH_MEMORY_MODES=host make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_AFFINITIES</code> | `unpinned pinned` | A space-separated subset of `unpinned` and `pinned`. | Select pinned and unpinned process variants. | <code>UIB_BENCH_AFFINITIES=pinned make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_MTUS</code> | `1500 4096 8192` | A space-separated list of positive byte counts. | Select protocol MTUs traversed by the matrix runner. | <code>UIB_BENCH_MTUS='1500 4096' make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_PIN_CPU</code> | First allowed CPU; namespace peers use first two when available. | A CPU identifier accepted by `taskset -c`. | Select the pinned CPU; an explicit value pins both namespace peers to it. | <code>UIB_BENCH_PIN_CPU=3 make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_OUTPUT</code> | A timestamped directory below `/tmp`. | A writable directory path. | Select the directory receiving CSV, text, and Markdown output. | <code>UIB_BENCH_OUTPUT=/tmp/uib-results make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_DOCUMENT</code> | `docs/benchmark-results.md` | A writable Markdown file path. | Select the benchmark reference document to update. | <code>UIB_BENCH_DOCUMENT=/tmp/results.md make benchmark-doc</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_SYNC_DOCUMENT</code> | `docs/sync-async-benchmark.md` | A writable Markdown file path. | Select the sync/async comparison document to update. | <code>UIB_BENCH_SYNC_DOCUMENT=/tmp/sync.md make benchmark-doc</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_REUSE</code> | `0` | `0` or `1` | Reuse CSV files in the output directory instead of rerunning. | <code>UIB_BENCH_REUSE=1 UIB_BENCH_OUTPUT=/tmp/run make benchmark-doc</code> |
| <code>UIB_BENCH_MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT</code> | `5` percent | A non-negative percentage. | Set the maximum aggregate UDP regression accepted by docs. | <code>UIB_BENCH_MAX_REGRESSION_PERCENT=3 make benchmark-doc</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_VARIANTS</code> | `rocev2:dcqcn rocev2:none uet:rccc uet:nscc uet:none` | Space-separated `protocol:algorithm` pairs supported by the runner. | Select protocol and congestion-control pairs for the resilience matrix. UET with DCQCN must use the explicit `dcqcn-experimental` name. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_VARIANTS='rocev2:dcqcn uet:rccc' make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_CONDITIONS</code> | `clean latency drops reordered drops-reordered` | Space-separated checked-in network profile names. | Select the netem conditions applied to every selected congestion variant. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_CONDITIONS='clean drops reordered' make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_MATRIX</code> | Unset; the variants and conditions form a Cartesian product. | Space-separated `protocol:algorithm:condition` entries. | Replace the Cartesian product with an exact resilience benchmark matrix. Do not set this together with variant or condition selectors. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_MATRIX='rocev2:dcqcn:drops uet:rccc:reordered' make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_ITERATIONS</code> | `1000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set measured operations per resilience matrix entry. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_ITERATIONS=10000 make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_SIZE</code> | `16384` bytes | A positive 32-bit byte count. | Set the payload size for resilience matrix operations. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_SIZE=65536 make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_WINDOW</code> | `16` | A positive operation count. | Set the maximum in-flight operation count for each resilience entry. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_WINDOW=64 make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_MTU</code> | `1500` bytes | A positive path MTU no larger than `4096` for RoCEv2 comparisons. | Set one common path MTU for all resilience matrix entries. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_MTU=4096 make benchmark-all</code> |
| <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_TIMEOUT</code> | `120` seconds | A positive integer number of seconds. | Set the per-entry timeout, including retry delays caused by impairments. | <code>UIB_CC_BENCH_TIMEOUT=300 make benchmark-all</code> |

## Namespace benchmark harness

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_KEEP_ON_FAILURE</code> | `0` | `0` or `1` | Keep failed namespaces, interfaces, processes, and logs. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_KEEP_ON_FAILURE=1 make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED</code> | `0` | `0` or `1` | Fail instead of skipping when namespace prerequisites are absent. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED=1 make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_AFFINITIES</code> | `unpinned pinned` | A space-separated subset of `unpinned` and `pinned`. | Select pinned and unpinned namespace benchmark variants. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_AFFINITIES=pinned make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_MTUS</code> | `1500 4096 8192` | A space-separated list of positive byte counts. | Select path MTUs for namespace benchmark endpoints. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_MTUS='1500 4096' make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_PROTOCOLS</code> | `rocev2 uet dummy` | A space-separated subset of supported protocols. | Select protocols for the namespace benchmark matrix. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_PROTOCOLS=uet make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_MEMORY</code> | `host dmabuf` | A space-separated subset of `host` and `dmabuf`. | Select host and DMA-BUF namespace benchmark variants. | <code>UIB_NAMESPACE_MEMORY=host make namespace-benchmark-test</code> |

## Test and scaling harnesses

| Variable | Default | Accepted values | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <code>UIB_TEST_PROTOCOL</code> | `rocev2` | `rocev2`, `uet`, or `dummy` | Select the protocol used by standard ibverbs tool tests. | <code>UIB_TEST_PROTOCOL=uet make uet-tools-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_PORT</code> | `4791` | `1` through `65535` | Select the protocol service port used by standard tool tests. | <code>UIB_TEST_PORT=5432 UIB_TEST_PROTOCOL=uet make uib-tools-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_ITERS</code> | `64` | A positive integer. | Set the operation count used by standard tool tests. | <code>UIB_TEST_ITERS=256 make uib-tools-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_LINK_MTU</code> | `1500` | An integer from `576` through `65535`. | Set both veth link MTUs used by standard ibverbs tool tests. The harness derives and advertises the largest UIB active MTU that fits the link. | <code>UIB_TEST_LINK_MTU=576 make uib-tools-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_DROP_TX</code> | Unset and disabled. | Any non-empty value drops one eligible packet. | Inject one transmit loss to exercise protocol recovery. | <code>UIB_TEST_DROP_TX=1 ./tests/loopback</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_ERROR_TEST</code> | Unset and disabled. | Any non-empty value. | Run UET semantic error checks after the normal loopback operation matrix. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_ERROR_TEST=1 ./tests/loopback</code> |
| <code>UIB_UET_ERROR_ONLY</code> | Unset and disabled. | Any non-empty value. | Run only UET semantic error checks. This keeps deterministic loss injection available for the first request and its guaranteed response. | <code>UIB_PROTOCOL=uet UIB_UET_ERROR_ONLY=1 UIB_TEST_DROP_TX=1 ./tests/loopback</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_GPU_DMABUF_FD</code> | Unset; the external GPU DMA-BUF test skips. | A valid inherited file-descriptor number. | Supply an external GPU DMA-BUF descriptor to the import test. | <code>UIB_TEST_GPU_DMABUF_FD=9 ./tests/external_dmabuf_test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_GPU_DMABUF_OFFSET</code> | `0` | A non-negative byte offset. | Set the starting offset in an external GPU DMA-BUF. | <code>UIB_TEST_GPU_DMABUF_OFFSET=4096 ./tests/external_dmabuf_test</code> |
| <code>UIB_TEST_JOBS</code> | `4` | A positive make job count. | Set parallel jobs for optional-feature rebuild tests. | <code>UIB_TEST_JOBS=16 make optional-features-test</code> |
| <code>UIB_SCALE_THREADS</code> | `4` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set worker threads in the QP lookup scaling benchmark. | <code>UIB_SCALE_THREADS=8 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_SCALE_LOOKUPS</code> | `1000000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set lookups per worker in the QP scaling benchmark. | <code>UIB_SCALE_LOOKUPS=5000000 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_SCALE_TRAFFIC_ITERS</code> | `30000` | A positive integer. | Set traffic iterations for scaling protocol measurements. | <code>UIB_SCALE_TRAFFIC_ITERS=100000 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_LANES</code> | `1 2 4 8` | Space-separated positive integers from `1` through `32`. | Select independent context/QP lane counts for the context-scaling benchmark. Each lane uses a distinct UDP port pair. | <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_LANES="1 4 8" make context-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_TRIALS</code> | `3` | A positive integer. | Set the number of measurements for every context/QP lane count. | <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_TRIALS=5 make context-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_PORT_BASE</code> | `22400` | A positive port number no greater than `65400`. | Set the first loopback control port. Data ports begin 64 ports later. Change this value when another local service uses the default range. | <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_PORT_BASE=24000 make context-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_TIMEOUT</code> | `120` | A positive number of seconds. | Set the timeout for each server or client process in a scaling trial. | <code>UIB_CONTEXT_SCALE_TIMEOUT=300 make context-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_COUNTS</code> | `1 2 4 8` | Space-separated positive integers from `1` through `256`. | Select QP counts for the shared-context scaling benchmark. All QPs in one measurement share a context, CQ, memory region, and transport endpoint. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_COUNTS="1 4 8" make qp-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_QPS</code> | `1` | A positive integer from `1` through `256`. | Select one QP count when running `examples/qp_scaling_bench` directly. The matrix harness sets this variable from `UIB_QP_SCALE_COUNTS`. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_QPS=4 ./examples/qp_scaling_bench</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_POSTING</code> | `parallel` | `parallel` or `serial` | Select persistent per-QP posting workers or one serial posting thread in the shared-context benchmark. Use `serial` as the single-producer control. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_POSTING=serial make qp-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_TRIALS</code> | `3` | A positive integer. | Set the number of measurements for each shared-context QP count. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_TRIALS=5 make qp-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_TIMEOUT</code> | `120` | A positive number of seconds. | Set the timeout for one shared-context scaling measurement. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_TIMEOUT=300 make qp-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_PORT</code> | `22550` | A positive port number no greater than `65534`. | Set the first local UDP port used by the shared-context scaling benchmark. Its peer uses the following port. | <code>UIB_QP_SCALE_PORT=24550 make qp-scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_MR_SCALE_LOOKUPS</code> | `1000000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set lookups in the registered-memory scaling benchmark. | <code>UIB_MR_SCALE_LOOKUPS=5000000 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_PROVIDER_CONTEXTS</code> | `64` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set contexts created by the provider dispatch benchmark. | <code>UIB_PROVIDER_CONTEXTS=128 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_PROVIDER_LOOKUPS</code> | `1000000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set calls made by the provider dispatch benchmark. | <code>UIB_PROVIDER_LOOKUPS=5000000 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
| <code>UIB_PROVIDER_WR_ITERS</code> | `100000` | A positive 32-bit integer. | Set calls made by the provider WR translation benchmark. | <code>UIB_PROVIDER_WR_ITERS=1000000 make scaling-benchmark</code> |
